english.note: Use this for bodily matters or injuries, as opposed to mental ones.

exampleSentences.english: You need to keep physical wounds clean.
exampleSentences.traditional: 身體上嘅傷口要保持清潔。
exampleSentences.jyutping: san1 tai2 soeng6 ge3 soeng1 hau2 jiu3 bou2 ci4 cing1 git3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to describe something relating to the human body.

exampleSentences.english: The doctor said the injury would have lasting corporal effects.
exampleSentences.traditional: 醫生話呢個傷對身體上嘅影響會持續好耐。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ni1 go3 soeng1 deoi3 san1 tai2 soeng6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 wui5 ci4 zuk6 hou2 noi6
